rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that something is extremely so.

example.english: I’m desperately tired and want to sleep right away.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 gui6 soeng2 zik1 hak1 fan3

rows.note: Use this for reckless action carried out while risking serious injury or death.

example.english: They drove desperately, completely ignoring the danger.
example.traditional: 佢哋搏命咁揸車，完全唔理危險。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bok3 meng6 gam2 zaa1 ce1 jyun4 cyun4 m4 lei5 ngai4 him2
